title: PDEAgent-Bench: A Multi-Metric, Multi-Library Benchmark for PDE Solver Generation
abstract: arXiv:2605.09636v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: PDE-to-solver code generation aims to automatically synthesize executable numerical solvers from partial differential equation (PDE) specifications. This task requires not only understanding the mathematical structure of PDEs, but also selecting appropriate discretization schemes and solver configurations, and correctly implementing the resulting formulations in finite-element method (FEM) libraries. translated_title: PDEAgent-Bench：面向偏微分方程求解器生成的多指标、多库基准测试
translated_abstract: 偏微分方程（PDE）到求解器的代码生成旨在根据偏微分方程规范自动合成可执行的数值求解器。这项任务不仅需要理解偏微分方程的数学结构，还需要选择合适的离散化格式和求解器配置，并在有限元方法（FEM）库中正确实现所得的公式。现有的代码生成基准主要评估语法正确性，或在预定义测试用例上的成功率。据我们所知，目前尚无专门针对偏微分方程到求解器代码生成的公开可用基准，而通用代码基准无法完全捕捉数值求解偏微分方程所面临的独特挑战，例如确保求解器的精度、效率以及与专业有限元库的兼容性。我们提出了PDEAgent-Bench，据我们所知，这是首个多指标、多库的基准（摘要在此处中断）。
tldr: 本文提出了PDEAgent-Bench，据我们所知这是首个针对偏微分方程求解器代码生成的多指标、多库基准测试，填补了现有通用代码基准无法评估数值求解偏微分方程独特挑战（如求解器精度、效率和专业有限元库兼容性）的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PDEAgent-Bench, the first multi-metric, multi-library benchmark for PDE solver code generation, filling the gap left by general-purpose code benchmarks that fail to capture the unique challenges of numerical PDE solving such as solver accuracy, efficiency, and compatibility with professional FEM libraries.
